payload.title: Multi-app routing + per-app projection/job registries
payload.description: The Rust port runs a single _default app (inspect.rs note). Port appRegistry.resolveByPath (basePath stripping + activeAppId), per-app projection registries (jobs/worker.rs + gateway projection subscribe), and per-app job handler registries (worker.rs 'later story'). Carry over the FR-200 + tenant-app-isolation audit fixes.
